name: Capex
doc: Installed cost per kWp (Fraunhofer ISE 2024, southern Germany)

name: OM
doc: Operation and maintenance cost per kWp and year

name: Yield
doc: Energy yield per kWp and year in the first year

name: Degradation
doc: Fraction of output lost each year

name: Debt Share
doc: Share of the investment financed by debt

name: Inflation
doc: General inflation per year, to turn the nominal rate into a real one

name: kWh per MWh
doc: Conversion from EUR per kWh to EUR per MWh

name: Year Length
doc: Conversion: one Year, the unit that an exponent measured in years is divided by

name: Real WACC
doc: Real weighted average cost of capital: the nominal WACC deflated by inflation

name: Output
doc: Energy produced in the year, after degradation

name: LCOE
doc: Levelised cost of energy: discounted costs over discounted energy

problem: What does a kilowatt hour from solar PV cost over the life of the plant, and which inputs move it most?

title: Reproduce the published cost
test: LCOE in 2024 for southern Germany lies between 40.5 and 41.5 EUR/MWh
